lxc_a47ffb5b7a90fb99.text: Read a short About Me reading about Ken at home.

lxc_0888cade2fc59d7f.text: Then students use the same talk with blanks to speak.

lxc_311cece5073c2f40.text: He lives in Osaka with his wife.

lxc_d3692c13d2959e7f.text: He works at a small camera shop.

lxc_35b1acc02bd577d0.text: These first lines give clear facts about Ken’s daily life.

lxc_26be1dc361c6017a.text: The words from and lives have different jobs.

lxc_af0a09ac6bbaedfa.text: From tells us his home city and country.

lxc_3ac01707e59bcbb3.text: Lives tells us where his home is now.

lxc_40fb3e6d21a8a80f.text: The next lines tell us about his work and his busy week.

lxc_ec9374e731c34d0d.text: When he has free time, he likes walking.

lxc_f63215ced1f8a83e.text: He also likes taking photos, because the streets are quiet.

lxc_ed3a5205aa30994a.text: Free time is time away from work and other things that must be done.

lxc_caef59804c7a1097.text: Ken names two things he likes.

lxc_e70fd91af3d7a886.text: They are walking and taking photos.

lxc_1a63ec1ef1153a5b.text: The word because gives a reason.

lxc_747d893da7bd85a9.text: Ken enjoys taking photos when the streets are quiet.

lxc_d51a0c5e9a66240e.text: This small detail helps us understand what he likes about this time.

lxc_f109490b2538c884.text: On weekends, he usually walks and drinks coffee.

lxc_15b3bd013abaa6b7.text: Sometimes he goes to a park with his wife.

lxc_7f366401d382498e.text: His favorite place is Osaka Castle park, because the walk is easy and the trees are nice.

lxc_a63136a14981ebe8.text: This part tells us about regular weekend activities.

lxc_8e46d6b72ddf0ef5.text: Usually shows something that happens on many weekends.

lxc_d23b557b1090d658.text: Sometimes shows something that happens, but not every weekend.

lxc_6967d4e5a7d4c1dd.text: Ken also names one favorite place.

lxc_b5da280b7541b51f.text: The easy walk and nice trees make the park special to him.

lxc_db4d7ed24a341c04.text: He started to like them because his father had one.

lxc_4c41f0c7e4e3e2b5.text: These days, he takes photos of the river.

lxc_e14ec2b1f9179afa.text: This part connects the past with the present.

lxc_365b237b494df737.text: Ken’s father had an old camera, and this was the start of Ken’s interest.

lxc_9251467266954523.text: These days moves the reading to his life now.

lxc_732c2eb6a52c1d62.text: He now uses his interest by taking river photos.

lxc_6c068d6d8b234a14.text: The three sentences form a simple path from his father’s camera to an activity that Ken does now.

lxc_144fb22f4f2d707b.text: Later, he wants to visit Kyoto for a weekend.

lxc_745ccec38455c01e.text: One thing he wants to try is a night photo class.

lxc_d9be35e43fcbf77d.text: He thinks it would be fun because city lights look different at night.

lxc_ffc8c163a4139f6b.text: Now the reading moves from Ken’s present life to his future plans.

lxc_e49b3aa27e9303fa.text: Later shows that the visit is not happening now.

lxc_35f44bf15f90077e.text: Wants to try introduces a new activity.

lxc_8d6d52ee56198eeb.text: Ken also gives a reason for his choice.

lxc_e97010510a1a6aae.text: Night changes how city lights look, so a night class may give him a new way to take photos.

lxc_6f8594e0ddba3264.text: Now make the talk your own.

lxc_3bef79dfa59f761f.text: Each blank needs a true detail about you.

lxc_c99c7911962a57fc.text: Start with your name and home.

lxc_4081ba9e920809d8.text: Then add work, free time, weekends, a favorite place, an interest, and a future plan.

lxc_a4e8d516b8b7514d.text: The lines with because ask for reasons.

lxc_9edd6ba4276ad4f5.text: Reasons help the listener understand your choices.

lxc_e1a8a66bd0b472ce.text: You can complete all the lines, or choose the lines that share the clearest picture of your life.

lxc_c675bb6d722d21cf.text: I usually have a busy week, but when I have free time, I like ________.

lxc_814219f7f8ce5ac6.text: I became interested in it because ________.

lxc_97126f7572175dda.text: In the future, I would like to ________.

lxc_f0758c08365c90ca.text: One thing I want to learn or try is ________.

lxc_8ec51dc5c0869c20.text: I think it would be interesting because ________.
